assumptions: The box tips into the open lateral floor space without introducing a pulling agent.

constraints.relation: bottom shift is followed by increasing rotation toward floor

entities.mention: the same centered tall tan cardboard box

events.description: one visible bottom corner of the tan box moves sideways
events.observable: the bottom edge changes lateral support before rotation

global_semantic: The centered tall tan cardboard box shifts at one lower corner, tips across the gray floor, and remains on its side.

predicates.observable: lateral movement of one bottom corner on gray floor
predicates.subject: box

predicates.observable: angle of the tall rectangular silhouette
predicates.subject: box

protected_predicates: same tall tan cardboard surface and rectangular proportions
smooth gray floor, white wall, baseboard, lighting, and static frontal camera remain unchanged
no pulling hand or tool is added

stages.observable_check: The rectangular silhouette stays vertical during the first bottom-edge shift.
stages.positive: The centered tan box remains vertical while one pictured lower corner begins sliding across gray floor.

violations.text: The tan box already lies horizontally before its pictured bottom support shifts.

stages.observable_check: Lateral corner motion appears before increasing long-axis angle.
stages.positive: The bottom support shifts sideways before the tall tan silhouette first rotates from vertical.

violations.text: The centered tan box rotates before either pictured lower corner moves sideways.

stages.observable_check: The rectangular silhouette angle increases without changing box identity or shape.
stages.positive: The same tan box rotates progressively through the open floor space toward one broad side.

violations.text: The pictured bottom edge shifts while the tall box remains perfectly vertical.

stages.observable_check: A broad side becomes floor-supported and angular motion reaches zero.
stages.positive: One broad tan side reaches the smooth gray floor and the box stops rotating.

violations.text: The tan box remains diagonally balanced without placing a broad side on gray floor.

stages.observable_check: One tan box keeps one side-supported horizontal pose through the end.
stages.positive: The same tan cardboard box remains horizontal on one side across the unchanged gray floor.

violations.text: The pictured side-lying box rises vertical again during final frames.
Vertical and horizontal copies of the tan box coexist on gray floor.

effects.direction: tall silhouette rotates toward gray floor

warnings: No pulling agent is visible, so the first auditable cause is lower-corner motion; boxes are estimated and unapproved.
